# Velair 1.8.0-beta.3

This beta follows up on reports from people testing the 1.8.0 series. It adds schedule blocks that send climate options without a temperature, corrects Comfort reading freshness, and addresses another Room Assist case that could switch a zone to Manual.

## ✨ Added

- Schedules can now apply one or more supported presets, fan modes, swing settings, or target humidity without sending a temperature or HVAC mode command. These option-only blocks also work in Profiles and templates; Velair does not explicitly turn on an off climate ([#30](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/30)).

## 🚀 Improved

- Schedule, Profile, and template editors now explain what a block with **Keep current mode** will send. They also warn when a temperature target may be incompatible with the mode active when the block runs ([#30](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/30)).

## 🛠️ Fixed

- Fixed a remaining case where a delayed climate update from Room Assist could be mistaken for a manual change and switch a zone out of Automatic ([#28](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/28)).
- Comfort now marks direct sensor readings stale when Home Assistant stops reporting them, even if their last value has not changed. Repeated reports of the same value keep the reading current. Usable temperature and humidity readings from climate attributes remain visible with unverifiable freshness. Velair also ignores retained readings from unavailable climates and no longer treats target humidity as measured humidity ([#32](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/32)).

## 🧭 Notes

- **Data freshness** now appears immediately after **Data sources** in Comfort. It identifies the direct sensors covered by **Stale after** and groups information about readings whose freshness cannot be verified; missing and stale readings still show warnings.
- Portable exports now use model version 12 to support option-only blocks. Existing backups remain importable, but earlier Velair versions cannot import a new version 12 export.
- After updating through HACS, restart Home Assistant and refresh the browser or companion app. If the previous interface remains visible, perform a hard refresh or clear the site cache.
